title: Dilemma Attacks
shortDefinition: A dilemma is two or more threats where defending one line exposes another.
whyItMatters: At higher levels, opponents do not give single finishes; you need chains based on reactions.
deepExplanation: Good dilemmas start from control. In Back Control, defending the neck exposes arm trap; clearing hooks exposes Mount. Attacking becomes designed bad choices, not luck.
beginnerView: Prepare the second attack when the first is blocked.
advancedView: Build branches where every defense keeps you in a better hierarchy.
